	The MTV Video Music Awards return Sunday night with one of the show’s biggest lineups in years, including Madonna’s first VMA performance in more than two decades, a Dolly Parton tribute from Kacey Musgraves and the world premiere of a new Taylor Swift music video.

	The 2026 MTV VMAs air live Sunday, Sept. 27 at 7:30 p.m. ET/4:30 p.m. PT from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. The ceremony will broadcast on CBS and simulcast on MTV, while cord-cutters can stream the entire show live on Paramount+. While Paramount+ costs $8.99/month, viewers can also stream the VMAs live online free through DirecTV, currently offering a 5-day trial.


	Snoop Dogg will host this year’s VMAs, which return to Los Angeles for the first time since 2017. Madonna, the night’s most-nominated artist with 11 nods, is set to open the show with her first VMA performance in 23 years, marking her first live appearance on the awards stage since her memorable 2003 performance alongside Britney Spears and Christina Aguilera.

	The performance lineup also includes LISA, RAYE, Shaboozey, Gunna, Sienna Spiro, GENER8ION and Yung Lean. LISA will give the television debut of her new single “SaWaDiKa,” while GENER8ION and Yung Lean will premiere “STORM II” onstage. Shaboozey, meanwhile, will perform “Cowgirl” before being joined by Gunna for the first broadcast performance of their collaboration “High Noon.” RAYE and Sienna Spiro will both make their VMAs performance debuts.

	One of the night’s most anticipated moments will be a special tribute to Dolly Parton, with Musgraves returning to the VMAs stage for her first performance at the ceremony in five years. Musgraves, who is nominated this year for best country for “Dry Spell,” will perform in honor of the country music icon.


	There will also be a tribute to George Michael featuring RAYE, sombr and Teddy Swims, while Nirvana will receive this year’s Video Vanguard Award, 34 years after the band first performed at the VMAs in 1992.

	Swift will have an especially busy night. In addition to receiving the inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honors — a new award recognizing musicians whose directing work has advanced music video storytelling — she will debut the music video for her new single “Patient Zero” during the telecast. Swift directed the video, which stars Colin Farrell and Dakota Johnson.

	The honor recognizes Swift’s increasingly expansive body of work behind the camera, including videos for “The Man,” “cardigan,” “willow,” “Anti-Hero,” “Bejeweled,” “Fortnight” and “The Fate of Ophelia,” as well as “All Too Well: The Short Film.” Swift enters this year’s ceremony with nine nominations.

	The 2026 MTV Video Music Awards air live Sunday, Sept. 27 at 7:30 p.m. ET/4:30 p.m. PT on CBS and MTV. Stream the VMAs live online free on DirecTV.

	Some of the best athletes in the world are in Japan this week for the 2026 Asian Games, a multi-sport competition held every four years for countries in Asia.

	This year’s Asian Games take place in Nagoya, located in the Aichi Prefecture in Japan, and Aichi–Nagoya 2026 makes the 20th edition of the event. Almost 20,000 athletes will compete for medals across 43 disciplines in Nagoya, including Filipino tennis star Alexandra Eala, Chinese Olympic swimming champion Pan Zhanle, Filipino Olympic gymnastics champ Carlos Yulo and the Indian men’s cricket team, who are the current title holders of the Twenty20 World Cup, Champions Trophy and Asia Cup.

	
		How to Watch Asian Games 2026	

	A number of Asian broadcasters are airing the Asian Games live on TV and online through their respective streaming channels, including CCTV5 in China, RTM in Malaysia, MeWatch in Singapore and KBS and SBS in South Korea.

	You can access all of those livestreams for free via a virtual private network like ExpressVPN. Download ExpressVPN (starting at just $2.99) and set your location to any of the countries above to watch an Asian Games live feed online for free.

	Here in the U.S., viewers can also watch the Asian Games online and on television through Willow TV (available on Sling or Amazon Prime Video for just $10). Willow TV is best known for its international cricket coverage, but the streamer will also have hours of live coverage of the other sports as well. You can also access replays of past events.

	Willow is available on its own through Prime Video, or as part of the Sling Desi Binge Plus package, which also includes access to Desi-themed series and movies on SonyLIV, Jio Cinema, Simply South and more. Sling has the package marked down to $10 for a limited time.


	Both Sling and Prime Video let you watch the Asian Games online through Willow on your phone, tablet, computer or smart TV. 

	The 2026 Asian Games kicked off on Sept. 19 and run through Oct 4. For those wanting to watch Eala play, the women’s tennis tournament runs from Sept. 27 to Oct 3. Cricket, diving and athletics (track and field) are also among the sports still being contested this week.

	The Asian Games come on the heels of the 2026 Commonwealth Games, which were held in July for athletes from nations across the British Commonwealth — I.e. countries that are currently or were formerly part of the British Empire.

title: Adam Brody Calls for a ‘Free Palestine,’ Says He’s Never ‘Ducked’ Politics: ‘I Just Answer the Questions I’m Asked’
description: Adam Brody is calling for a “free Palestine” and explaining why his political activism doesn’t come up more often during his red-carpet and press ap
body:
Adam Brody is calling for a “free Palestine” and explaining why his political activism doesn’t come up more often during his red-carpet and press appearances.

	“I just answer the questions I’m asked,” the actor told GQ. “And it’s true. I’m not wearing a pin, so I’m not inviting a certain question, and perhaps I should. I really admire people who do. But 99% of what I’m asked about is about the show. I’m not trying to plead ignorance—here we are doing a political interview, so it makes sense that we wade into this territory—but I’ve never ducked a question, really, not a political question anyway.”
	

	The “O.C.” actor explained that while he hadn’t spoken publicly about the Israel-Gaza issue before, it comes up “a lot” for him in private. He then made his stance on the conflict clear: “Put me down as thinking it’s a genocide,” he said. “Put me down as wanting a free Palestine. It’s awful that it’s taken so much death and misery, but it does feel like it’s reaching a breaking point that it should have a while ago.”


	Brody, who isn’t on social media, also defended his decision to remain offline. “I think being off social media has been the healthiest thing. I’m forced to use a lot of tools and products where I don’t believe in the heads of those companies, but I’m sure as shit not going to be on anything that Elon Musk is a part of,” he said. “I know people are doing really good work on [X], and I’m really glad about that. But it’s not for me, and I don’t have any guilt about not being on it. Sorry, I feel great about it.”
	

	Brody has starred in Netflix’s romantic comedy series “Nobody Wants This” as rabbi Noah Roklov since Season 1 premiered in 2024. Season 3 is due on the streamer on Oct. 22.

	“That ‘first time’ feeling, all over again. After recommitting to each other at the end of last season, Joanne (Kristen Bell) and Noah (Adam Brody) are moving into a home — and a relationship — that finally feels solid, embracing every exciting ‘first’ that comes with building their life together,” reads the official description for the new season. “Sasha (Timothy Simons) and Esther (Jackie Tohn) are thrust back into the dating world, whether they like it or not, stumbling through all the awkwardness (and unexpected thrill) of getting to know someone new, right as Morgan (Justine Lupe) takes her career to the next level, on her way to becoming an (almost) media sensation. Meanwhile, Sasha and Morgan have been circling something neither of them has been able to admit to.”

	Erin Foster created the series and executive produces along with Jenni Konner and Bruce Eric Kaplan, who both serve as showrunners.

title: ‘Avengers: Endgame Encore’ Scores Massive $86 Million Globally, Brad Pitt’s ‘Heart of the Beast’ Launches to $50 Million Worldwide
description: “Avengers: Endgame” returned to theaters and assembled a massive $86 million globally, including $26 million in North America and $60 million overse
body:
“Avengers: Endgame” returned to theaters and assembled a massive $86 million globally, including $26 million in North America and $60 million overseas.

	Disney and Marvel’s 2019 blockbuster was already the second-highest-grossing movie in box office history with $2.79 billion; this weekend’s haul brings the movie’s staggering tally to $2.88 billion. It’s only $39 million behind 2009’s “Avatar,” which is the biggest worldwide release of all time with $2.9 billion.
	

	Disney and Marvel reissued “Avengers: Endgame” to stoke excitement for “Avengers: Doomsday,” which opens in December. The upcoming comic book tentpole, which reunites just about every superhero on this planet (and others) and reintroduces Robert Downey Jr. not as Iron Man but as the villain Doctor Doom, is expected to be one of the biggest movies of the year. This re-release offered new footage as well as a chance to introduce viewers to the studio’s new take on premium large formats called “Infinity Vision.” It’s not a new technology but rather a “certification” that guarantees movie theaters will “meet rigorous technical standards,” per Disney. (As a note, “Avengers: Doomsday” won’t have access to Imax, the most ubiquitous of the PLFs, because “Dune: Part III” debuts on the same day and has the entire Imax footprint exclusively for three weeks.)


	“Bringing ‘Avengers: Endgame’ back to theaters with an exclusive look at ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ is a smart way to give audiences a reason to revisit the film on the big screen and build excitement for what comes next,” says Rentrack’s head of marketplace trends Paul Dergarabedian. “‘Avengers: Doomsday’ is poised for one of the biggest opening weekend performances of all time.”
	

	Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, “Avengers: Doomsday” will be the 39th installment in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. It’s the most successful film franchise in history with $35.07 billion across all movies, a benchmark that was recently lifted by this summer’s juggernaut “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” with $2.2 billion.

	“Avengers: Endgame Encore,” which the re-release has been dubbed, beat out several new releases to top domestic and global box office charts. Including this weekend’s grosses, “Endgame” strengthened its position as the third-largest North American release of all time with $884 million. Meanwhile, in a new milestone, “Avengers: Endgame” became the second movie ever to clear $2 billion at the international box office.

	In terms of new releases, Paramount’s wilderness thriller “The Heart of the Beast” opened to $30.1 million from 63 markets. Along with a softer $20 million start in North America, the film has collected $50.1 million globally. Since it carries a hefty $82 million budget, “Heart of the Beast” will rely on staying power and interest at the international box office to recoup in its theatrical run. Reviews and word-of-mouth should help; “The Heart of the Beast” landed a strong 87% on Rotten Tomatoes and “A-” grade on CinemaScore exit polls. David Ayer (“The Beekeeper”) directed “Heart of Beast,” which stars Pitt as a retired veteran who navigates a brutal 58-mile trek to safety after he and his trusted combat dog survive a harrowing plane crash in the Alaskan wilderness.

	Another newcomer, Universal and DreamWorks Animation’s “Forgotten Island,” struggled with $7.8 million from 34 markets. The movie has yet to land in several key international territories. Globally, “Forgotten Island” has earned just $20.6 million, including a softer-than-expected $12.8 million domestically. Universal shelled out $80 million to produce the family film, so the studio needs the positive reviews and audience reception to help “Forgotten Island” stick around beyond its debut. Directed by Joel Crawford and Januel Mercado, the story follows around two best friends who get stranded in a mystical world. H.E.R., Dave Franco and Jenny Slate lead the voice cast.

	Earlier this week, Universal became the first to cross $5 billion worldwide in 2026, fueled by Christopher Nolan’s “The Odyssey” with $1.75 billion and “The Super Mario Galaxy Movie” with $1 billion.

schema.headline: ‘Avengers: Endgame Encore’ Scores Massive $86 Million Globally, Brad Pitt’s ‘Heart of the Beast’ Launches to $50 Million Worldwide

title: Neil Patrick Harris to Star in ‘Damn Yankees’ Broadway Revival
description:
A revival of “Damn Yankees,” starring Neil Patrick Harris and Julianne Hough, will open next spring on Broadway.

	It’s the first Broadway revival o
body:
A revival of “Damn Yankees,” starring Neil Patrick Harris and Julianne Hough, will open next spring on Broadway.

	It’s the first Broadway revival of “Damn Yankees” in more than 30 years. Following last fall’s run at D.C.’s Arena Stage, this revised production features a book by Will Power and Dough Wright, with additional lyrics by Lynn Ahrens and direction and choreography by Sergio Trujillo. 


	“Damn Yankees,” which revolves around a middle-aged man who makes a Faustian bargain for his losing baseball team to somehow beat the unstoppable New York Yankees, debuted on Broadway in 1955 with Robert Shafer, Gwen Verdon, Ray Walston and Stephen Douglass. It won seven Tony Awards, including best musical. Richard Adler and Jerry Ross wrote the music and lyrics, with a book by George Abbott and Douglass Wallop. The show was last revived on Broadway in 1993 with Jarrod Emick, Bebe Neuwirth and Victor Garber.
	

	“’Damn Yankees’ has always been one of our great American musicals, but I wasn’t interested in simply reviving it,” says Trujillo. “This ‘revisal’ preserves the heart, wit and soaring score that audiences love and is a real opportunity to bring joy back into the theater. ‘Damn Yankees’ is a celebration of America, and I hope audiences see themselves in it and remind them of the magic that only a great American musical can deliver. Let’s play ball!”


	This revival moves the original 1950s-set story into the 21st century. Here’s the official logline: “It’s the early 2000s, and diehard baseball fan Joe Boyd dreams of seeing his beloved Baltimore Orioles return to glory. So when a charming stranger and his captivating accomplice arrive with an offer too good to refuse, Joe makes a deal that could give both him and his team a second chance. There’s just one catch…”
	

	Harris will play the devil in disguise known as Applegate, Hough is making her Broadway debut as Joe’s wife Lola and Austin Scott is playing Young Joe. The rest of the cast has yet to be announced.

	Harris won a Tony for the 2014 revival of “Hedwig and the Angry Inch” and has hosted the Tony Awards several times. He was recently on Broadway in “Art,” a play revival in which he starred alongside James Corden and Bobby Cannavale.

	“I’ve never done the big Broadway musical, with a big ensemble and dance numbers. It’s been a bucket list for me,” Harris said during a press conference on Sunday at Yankees Stadium. Of his character, he added, “Playing someone who is devilish is always good. It’s fun to be naughty. I want Applegate to be as alluring and puppet-mastery as possible.”

	“Damn Yankees” will play at the Marquis Theatre, with previews beginning on March 24 ahead of opening night on April 20. 

	In a first for Broadway, Major League Baseball and its production label MLB Studios will serve as a partner on the production.

	“Baseball is mythology. Broadway is mythology. They both deliver thrilling, unrepeatable live entertainment to millions of fans each year,” said Haley Swindal, who serves as lead producer with Lia Vollack (“MJ”). “Bringing them together — with MLB at the table and this extraordinary creative team — isn’t just a revival. It’s a collision of American icons.”

	Swindal is the granddaughter of legendary New York Yankees owner George Steinbrenner. Nicknamed “The Boss,” Steinbrenner was also a Broadway producer who invested in six productions, including the 1970 Tony Award-winner “Applause” and the 1974 musical “Seesaw.”

	Noah Garden, MLB’s deputy commissioner of business and media, added, “We’re thrilled to partner with the entire team on the return of ‘Damn Yankees’ to Broadway, led by such great talents in Neil, Julianne and Austin. It’s incredibly important that our game continues to resonate outside the diamond and into different areas of culture. Baseball and Broadway fans both love high drama, high stakes and high hopes that they’re about to watch something unforgettable happen. ‘Damn Yankees’ celebrates that shared spirit, and we’re proud to help bring that energy to the stage.”

schema.headline: Neil Patrick Harris to Star in ‘Damn Yankees’ Broadway Revival

title: Nat Geo Kicks Off New Multi-Year Doc Franchise With ‘Africa Earth’s Wild Home’
description: Unlike most conglomerate-owned media companies, National Geographic is still pouring money into documentaries. Their latest docuseries “Africa Earth
body: Unlike most conglomerate-owned media companies, National Geographic is still pouring money into documentaries. Their latest docuseries “Africa Earth’s Wild Home” is a seven-parter that took four years to make and employed over 50 people. It’s the first series in a multi-year franchise that will document the planet, one continent at a time.Nat Geo partnered with National Geographic Society’s global community of Explorers and scientists and Rolex’s Perpetual Planet Initiative to make the seven-series franchise.Nat Geo president Courteney Monroe says that the partnership demonstrates a “shared commitment to protecting our natural world.”“It’s proof of what’s possible when storytelling, science and a shared sense of purpose come together,” says Monroe. “Through this collaboration, we are expanding what natural history storytelling can reveal, whose voices it can elevate and how deeply it can connect audiences to the wonders of our planet.”“Africa Earth’s Wild Home” is narrated and executive produced by Academy Award nominee Wunmi Mosaku. It was filmed in nearly 30 African countries and used new technology and cutting-edge CGI to reveal the continent’s history and the forces that shaped its natural environments. To capture how Africa’s varied ecosystems shape the animals that live within them, film crews were sent to deserts, forests, jungles, mountains and islands.Showrunner and series editor Gavin Boyland says Africa became the first continent in the multi-year franchise because people often associate wildlife with Africa.“Africa got the best wildlife,” says Boyland. “It’s got the most spectacle. It’s got the charismatic animals. So, what we wanted to do from the outset is show people a different side of Africa. So, while we absolutely filmed lions and elephants and all the kind of familiar wildlife, but we also wanted to show different environments, different landscapes and different species that live in those landscapes as well.”Instead of reaching out to typical Western researchers and scientists, Boyland and his team went to Africa and approached wildlife guides, drivers, photographers, and locals who saw wildlife daily.“Those people were able to point us towards new behaviors,” says Boyland.“Africa Earth’s Wild Home” features sequences that have never been filmed before, including the smallest crocodile hunting bats in pitch-black caves, a grumpy black rain frog, a flying saucer beetle that digs trenches to harvest water from coastal fog, giant “vegetarian” land tortoises hunting birds, golden wolves hunting pelicans three times their size and a male fossa fighting to gain access to a female’s mating tree.“The series inspires us to look closer, learn more and care more deeply,” says Jill Tiefenthaler, CEO of National Geographic Society. “That’s the same passion that drives our National Geographic Explorers, who are working every day to understand and protect the natural world. With partners like Rolex and Disney, we magnify the impact of their work, inspiring millions to care about our planet and its future.”The final episode in “Africa Earth’s Wild Home” focuses on conservationists, photographers and scientists whose work safeguarding the continent underpins the series. Both the episode and the series build on a 70-year partnership between National Geographic and Rolex.“Across seven episodes, the extraordinary filmmaking reveals that protecting Africa’s wild heart starts with understanding its fragile ecosystems,” says Rolex director of communication and image Arnaud Boetsch. “By shining a spotlight on the Explorers and scientists working on the frontlines of conservation, the series promises to spark not just wonder but hope for the future.”“Africa Earth’s Wild Home” premieres Oct. 2 on National Geographic and streams on Disney+ and Hulu on Oct. 3. The series was produced by BBC Studios Natural History Unit for National Geographic.

schema.headline: Nat Geo Kicks Off New Multi-Year Doc Franchise With ‘Africa Earth’s Wild Home’

title: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Co-Director Explains It’s ‘Very Difficult’ to Evolve Marvel Characters, but ‘We Need to Surprise Ourselves’ and ‘Audiences’
description: “Avengers: Doomsday” co-director Anthony Russo has opened up about the pressure that comes with evolving the franchise’s iconic superhero characters
body:
“Avengers: Doomsday” co-director Anthony Russo has opened up about the pressure that comes with evolving the franchise’s iconic superhero characters, explaining that finding the balance between moving the story forward and honoring those already-beloved characters can be “very difficult.”

	“It’s a very difficult part of the process because, I mean, we basically just have to use our own meters because we love the characters, we love the history, we love them in the same way that many fans do,” Russo said during a Q&A after a screening of “Avengers: Endgame Encore” (via GamesRadar+).
	

	He continued: “But the one thing we always like to remind people of, you know, fandom does not speak with a single voice. There’s a wide variety of opinion in terms of who responds to which characters and which versions of which characters people respond to, it’s a very complex relationship that people have with the characters.”


	Russo also said that he and his brother and co-director Joe have “a lot of respect for the storytelling journey that these characters have had up to this point.” “That’s part of their magic, a big part of their magic. But at the same time, we need to surprise ourselves in terms of who those characters are, where they can go, what they can do, what can happen, and in doing that, we hopefully surprise audiences as well.”

	The director’s comments come nearly a year after an “Avengers: Doomsday” trailer spotlighted a much more serious Thor (Chris Hemsworth) than Marvel fans had seen in 2022’s “Thor: Love and Thunder.” The Taika Waititi-directed film performed well at the box office upon its release, but it divided fans who felt the character had become, in Hemsworth’s own words, “too silly.”
	

	Russo also revealed that the film’s full cast has yet to be announced. “The cast is so large, and we’ve announced some of the cast, and we haven’t announced some of the cast,” said Russo. “I get confused myself over who we’ve announced and not announced, so I have to just slow down.” So far, the confirmed cast includes Hemsworth, Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Paul Rudd, Simu Liu, Tom Hiddleston and more.

	“Avengers: Doomsday” will hit theaters on Dec. 18.

schema.headline: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Co-Director Explains It’s ‘Very Difficult’ to Evolve Marvel Characters, but ‘We Need to Surprise Ourselves’ and ‘Audiences’

title: Anthony Mackie Says Chris Evans Gave Him the ‘Avengers: Endgame’ Script Early, Revealing How He’d Become Captain America: ‘It Was Really Great and Really Emotional’
description: Chris Evans and Anthony Mackie’s bond goes beyond their shared roles as Captain America. They’re also close friends, so much so that Evans gave Mack
body:
Chris Evans and Anthony Mackie’s bond goes beyond their shared roles as Captain America. They’re also close friends, so much so that Evans gave Mackie early access to the “Avengers: Endgame” script, which is when the actor learned how he’d become the superhero. 

	“Chris Evans is somebody who I hold near and dear,” Mackie said in a recent interview with Cigar Aficionado. “We’re at Chris’ house, and because he’s Captain America, he gets the [script] pages first. So he’s like, ‘Yo, did you read the new scene?’ I’m like, ‘Nah, what’s up?’ So, he takes me down…and he gave me the script and let me read it. And it was really great and really emotional to learn it from a friend…I don’t know a lot of actors who would have appreciated or celebrated that moment with a fellow actor in that way because I was taking his job for all intents and purposes.”
	

	Evans first suited up as Captain America in 2011 in “Captain America: The First Avenger.” Mackie took over as the titular hero after receiving the iconic shield from Evans’ Captain America at the end of “Avengers: Endgame” in 2019. He led his first feature film as the superhero in 2025’s “Captain America: Brave New World.”  


	The Disney and Marvel 2019 blockbuster returned to theaters on Friday with extra footage as a special theatrical re-release leading up to “Avengers: Doomsday,” which comes out on Dec. 18. The re-release, titled “Avengers: Endgame Encore,” generated $26 million domestically over the weekend and $60 million overseas for a global tally of $86 million.

	The film was already the second-highest-grossing movie in box office history with $2.79 billion. After this weekend, the movie has grossed $2.88 billion.

schema.headline: Anthony Mackie Says Chris Evans Gave Him the ‘Avengers: Endgame’ Script Early, Revealing How He’d Become Captain America: ‘It Was Really Great and Really Emotional’

title: Chris Rock Says Infidelity and Struggling to ‘Make It’ Aren’t Just Hollywood Problems: ‘If You Got No Love, You’re Broke as F—k’
description: Chris Rock’s new movie “Misty Green” centers on a fictional actress (Rosalind Eleazar) mounting a Hollywood comeback after years in the throes of a
body:
Chris Rock’s new movie “Misty Green” centers on a fictional actress (Rosalind Eleazar) mounting a Hollywood comeback after years in the throes of a fading career. Misty’s journey pokes fun at some of the trappings of trying to “make it” in the entertainment industry, a pursuit that Rock himself is rejecting after his decades-spanning career in the biz.

	“Most people don’t make it, quote unquote, in Hollywood,” he told Variety at the “Misty Green” New York Film Festival premiere Saturday night. “Making it is, to me, where I’m at right now: my daughter having great kids. Having love in your life. If you got no love, you’re broke as f—k. That’s making it. All this other stuff, it’s just a job at the end of the day.”
	

	Rock plays a director who reunites with Misty after previously getting her booted from a “Cinderella” remake. (Earlier this month, he revealed to Variety that he originally imagined Donald Glover for the role.) Rock and Eleazar’s characters bond over their shared inability to remain faithful in relationships, playing into a familiar stereotype about Hollywood life.


	“I don’t think it’s a Hollywood thing, it’s just life,” Rock told Variety. “Our two characters bond over our infidelities. And, yeah, it’s a lot. But it’s show business, man. Rock ’n’ roll!”

	“Misty Green” also marks a real-life underdog moment for Eleazar, who tops the call sheet on a feature film for the first time. Following its premiere at the Toronto International Film Festival, Variety chief awards editor Clayton Davis declared that Eleazar “is a best actress contender that dares anyone in the room to argue otherwise.”
	

	“I’ve had bouts of not working,” Eleazar explained. “ I know many actors that have had huge bouts of not working and are constantly knocked down. And I have a lot of respect for actors that get up and do it all over again. But it’s also a universal story about any industry. It’s not just about actors.”

	Rounding out the ensemble are Adam Driver, Daniel Kaluuya, Anna Kendrick and Topher Grace. On just a $5 million price tag, Rock says he was able to assemble a star-studded cast for “Misty Green” by keeping the production local to Los Angeles.

	“That was one of the reasons I got this great cast, because I just happened to be filming in L.A., so that definitely helped,” he said. “I would love to film more movies in L.A. It’s a money thing at this point. Tax incentives would help.”

schema.headline: Chris Rock Says Infidelity and Struggling to ‘Make It’ Aren’t Just Hollywood Problems: ‘If You Got No Love, You’re Broke as F—k’

For RAYE and Sienna Spiro, the performance will be their VMAs debut.  Shaboozey will perform “Cowgirl” and then join Gunna for the first broadcast performance of their collaboration “High Noon,” while LISA will debut her new single “SaWaDiKa” on television. GENER8ION and Yung Lean will premiere “STORM II” onstage. 
Kacey Musgraves will perform the tribute to Parton, making her first appearance on the VMAs stage in five years. She is nominated for best country for “Dry Spell” this year. RAYE, Sombr and Teddy Swims will perform a tribute to George Michael. 34 years since Nirvana first performed at the VMAs in 1992, the band is set to receive this year’s Video Vanguard Award. 
In addition to her video premiere, Swift will also be honored with the inaugural Artist-Director Award. 
The 2026 MTV VMAs air live Sunday, Sept. 27 at 7:30 p.m. ET/4:30 p.m. PT from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.  Learn how to stream the show here.

title: Minnesota Coach Smears His Player's Blood Across His Face After Win
description:
Minnesota Football Coach
                          Celebrates Win with Linebacker's Blood Smeared
body:
Minnesota Football Coach
                          Celebrates Win with Linebacker's Blood Smeared Across Face
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              September 27, 2026
                            9:48 AM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            University of Minnesota's head coach got a little too into his post-win celebrations ... smearing the blood from a linebacker's mouth on his face!
      
    
      
      Minnesota head coach P.J. Fleck is FIRED UP after beating Washington 😭 pic.twitter.com/qBOgZHk39d
              @CFBONFOX
          
  
    
            Golden Gophers head coach P.J. Fleck was celebrating the team's road win against Washington at Husky Stadium Saturday when he ran up to linebacker Maverick Baranowski.
      
    
            The two hugged before P.J. took his hand and wiped it over Maverick's bloody mouth ... and let's just say, it was more than just a fleck.
      

            The end result gave total Patrick Bateman vibes ... with P.J. sporting a bloody cheek and a stain on his shirt.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Needless to say ... FOX Sports commentators Jack Kizer and Mark Helfrich were pretty shocked ... and pointed out that P.J. literally put the blood into the team's "blood, sweat and tears" win.
      
    
            Following the eyebrow-raising moment, Maverick said ... "I love that guy more than anyone, and it's just such an awesome opportunity to share that moment with him" calling him "a crazy man."
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            As for P.J. ... he called Maverick his official "blood brother" after their victory.

title: Democratic Sen. John Fetterman Accidentally Calls Himself a Lifelong Republican
description:
Sen. John Fetterman
                          I'm a Lifelong Republican ... Uh, I Mean Democrat
body:
Sen. John Fetterman
                          I'm a Lifelong Republican ... Uh, I Mean Democrat
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              September 27, 2026
                            2:53 PM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
        
                    
                  
      
    
            Sen. John Fetterman had a major slip of the tongue ... as the centrist Democrat -- who often splits from his party -- called himself a "lifelong Republican."
      
    
            Fetterman made the gaffe while he was attending the Texas Tribune Festival Saturday ... and the moderator had to remind him that he was in fact a Dem.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Fetterman -- wearing his classic sweatshirt and shorts uniform -- could be seen putting his hand to his head after the viral moment.
      

            He admitted of the mistake ... "I guarantee you that will break through. That will get clipped."
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            What can we say, John ... when you're right, you're far right. Kidding!
      
    
            Despite the error ... he firmly responded that he doesn't "have a reason" to join the GOP -- a party he crossed the aisle to side with around 26% of the time in 2025, according to voting stats.
      
    
            At the same time, Fetterman said ... "If the Democratic Party votes me out or expels me, they’re always entitled to do that."
      
    
            Bottom line ... it's complicated between Fetterman and the Dems, but they're sticking together for now.

title: Florence Pugh Speaks Out Against Alleged Cornell Gang Rape
description:
Florence Pugh
                          Alleged Cornell Gang Rape Makes Me Sick!!!
body:
Florence Pugh
                          Alleged Cornell Gang Rape Makes Me Sick!!!
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              September 27, 2026
                            1:05 PM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Florence Pugh is speaking out against the alleged gang rape of a 20-year-old student by 7 members of a Cornell University frat ... and she says the accusations make her "uneasy and sick and anxious."
      
    
            Offering a "few thoughts" on the alleged incident, Florence wrote ... "This is really a moment where we need our men to be as horrified and as sickened as us."
      
    
    
              
                
  
    
            Calling the alleged victim "strong willed," Florence said that the claims described in her lawsuit constitute a "killing of a soul."
      

            She also generally called out colleges and universities that "repeatedly fail women around the world" ... and admitted that those institutions that protect men against their accusers have left her "enraged."
      
    
            She added ... "This is a human issue, not a women’s issue. We are all involved. Men especially."
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            The suit, filed in Manhattan Supreme Court by a Jane Doe, claims that members of the Chi Phi fraternity at Cornell University sexually assaulted her after drugging her with ketamine.
      
    
            Jeremy Saland, one of the defendant's attorneys, has since denied the claims and called them false.

title: Presley Gerber's Ex-GF Cameron Rorrison Posts Heartbreaking Tribute After Tragic Death
description:
Presley Gerber's Ex-Girlfriend
                          Calls Him an 'Angel'
body:
Presley Gerber's Ex-Girlfriend
                          Calls Him an 'Angel'
                          In Emotional Post
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              September 27, 2026
                            5:47 AM PDT
                                                                      |
                                                                Updated 
                                  September 27, 2026
                                3:06 PM PDT
                                    
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Presley Gerber's ex-girlfriend Cameron Rorrison is remembering him after his tragic death last week ... and her emotional post is dedicated to what a good guy he was.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            Admitting the she had a "difficult time finding the words" ... Cameron said Presley had a "wide open heart" -- and will remember him for his "inspiring compassion" and "incredible understanding."
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            She wrote ... "One of the most amazing things about him was his humanity and his unique way of making every person, no matter who, feel as brilliant and important as the next. An incredibly beautiful quality I have yet to see as honest and pure in another person since."
      

            Ultimately Presley -- whom Cameron dated from 2018 to 2020 -- was an "angel in this life."
      
    
            She finished her sweet message ... "I hope you can feel the outpouring of love up there Pres."
      
    
            Cameron isn't the only one of his exes to speak out about his passing.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            Former flame Lexi Wood said he was "incredibly resilient" throughout his life ... and that he "loved so deeply, so purely."
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            Ex-GF Charlotte D'Alessio posted in her tribute she was "very angry" and wrote that Presley "deserved more time."
      
    
            As we first reported ... Presley died at 27 at a Santa Monica sober living facility. Police are investigating his death as a suspected overdose -- an official cause of death has yet to be released.
